summary: Immatics N.V. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that four abstracts have been selected for oral presentations at the upcoming 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting. The presentations cover clinical data from its cell therapy and bispecific portfolio, including PRAME-directed therapies and a MAGEA4/8 bispecific. There are no financial terms, transactions, board recommendations, or structural changes. The filing is a routine disclosure of scientific conference participation, not a special situation event. This is a Form 6-K equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K for material non-financial information.
